hyperedges.label: Backend-Free Preview Mode Architecture and Risks

nodes.label: SahlDZ/Resto Hub
nodes.rationale: Arabic RTL restaurant-management web app whose design work (onboarding tours + backend-free preview mode) is layered onto the existing restaurant-management application.

nodes.label: React 19 / TanStack Start / Vite / Tailwind / Radix Stack
nodes.norm_label: react 19 / tanstack start / vite / tailwind / radix stack

nodes.label: File-Based Routing
nodes.rationale: Route tree is generated from file routes; routeTree.gen.ts must never be edited by hand and must be regenerated through the TanStack/Vite dev workflow.

nodes.label: Supabase-Compatible Firebase Adapter
nodes.rationale: Backend boundary keeps existing application code importing 'supabase' while the name re-exports a Supabase-compatible adapter implemented over Firebase, avoiding a rewrite; behavior can therefore differ from real Supabase.

nodes.label: Backend-Free Preview Mode
nodes.rationale: App runs without a configured backend: Firebase init is optional (VITE_FIREBASE_* envs), and when absent the adapter returns preview-safe stubs; role-login/screen routes must keep real Firebase-backed behavior distinct from demo behavior.

nodes.label: Arabic RTL i18n
nodes.rationale: Primary interface language is Arabic; i18next/react-i18next is initialized with Arabic as both active and fallback language, with switching handled by UI.

nodes.label: Onboarding Tour System
nodes.rationale: Tour query params are numeric (?tour=1 activate, ?tour=0 disable) because TanStack Router JSON-serializes string search values with quotes.

nodes.label: TourAnnotation Bubble
nodes.rationale: Anchored with @floating-ui/react-dom using middlewareData.arrow and MutationObserver re-query so it works on lazy-mounted tour targets.

nodes.label: Preview (Mock) Mode
nodes.rationale: Preview restaurant (مطعم السهل), mock_ token detection and 24h expiry; demo screens are labelled 'وضع معاينة — بدون اتصال'.

nodes.label: Redesigned Auth Screens
nodes.rationale: Landing/auth pages redesigned with gold #D4A853 primary, Cairo font, and RTL direction.

nodes.label: Cashier Login Token Storage Fix
nodes.rationale: Real cashier login bug fixed: tokens were stored in localStorage while the screen read sessionStorage.

nodes.label: Remove Google and Apple Login Prompt
nodes.norm_label: remove google and apple login prompt

nodes.label: Email/Password Authentication
nodes.rationale: Must preserve email/password login, signup, password confirmation/validation, email verification, redirect logic, and existing rate limiting while removing Google/Apple social login entirely.

nodes.label: Firebase Adapter Social-Auth Cleanup
nodes.rationale: Remove or isolate unused social-auth code in the Firebase compatibility adapter only if unused elsewhere; do not change the Firebase-to-Supabase compatibility layer more than necessary and do not implement replacement auth providers.

nodes.label: Lint/tsc/Build Validation
nodes.rationale: After removal run npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build; verify no signInWithOAuth calls remain and no unused social-login handlers/imports survive.

nodes.label: Website Issues Report
nodes.rationale: Report is based on static code review, not full runtime testing; only problems with direct code evidence are documented.

nodes.label: Missing Vercel Build Script
nodes.rationale: npm run build referenced scripts/build-vercel.mjs which did not exist; the script was dropped so build is now just vite build.

nodes.label: Stub Server Functions
nodes.rationale: settings/telegram/daily-summary/summary-bot/ops-alerts server functions return fixed values; UI can suggest saving/sending succeeded while nothing is persisted.

nodes.label: Bypassable Client-Side Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Counters stored in window.localStorage are bypassable by clearing browser data or using another device; not real protection against guessing or distributed attacks.

nodes.label: Firebase Emulator Query Semantics
nodes.rationale: Stub returns empty/success without executing; like/ilike are mapped to >=, which is not text search, so preview results diverge from production.

nodes.label: Supabase-Compatible Naming
nodes.rationale: Client is exported under the name supabase but is really a Firebase adapter; unsupported operations may fail silently or differ from expected Supabase behavior.

nodes.label: OAuth Not Implemented (Closed)
nodes.rationale: Decision: signInWithOAuth returned {data:{},error:null} without opening a provider; social login (Google/Apple) was removed entirely leaving only email/password, so the item is closed.

nodes.label: Role Function Placeholders
nodes.rationale: Waiter/cashier/individual-chef/delivery/takeaway server functions are static or unbound to the database; screens may appear to work while data is never saved.

nodes.label: Authenticated Preview Fallback
nodes.rationale: Dashboard falls back to mock restaurant (مطعم السهل / mock-restaurant-id) after a restaurant/role lookup fails, so an authenticated user with no restaurant can see a demo screen instead of setup.

nodes.label: Incomplete i18n Support
nodes.rationale: ar/fr/en declared in supportedLngs but only ar resources registered; choosing French/English shows keys or Arabic fallback, and hardcoded Arabic strings exist in pages.

nodes.label: Missing OAuth Callback Route (Closed)
nodes.rationale: Decision: after complete removal of social login there are no OAuth endpoints and no callback route needed; item closed.

nodes.label: Predictable Preview Tokens
nodes.rationale: mock_waiter / mock_chef / mock_cashier tokens are fine for demo only but dangerous if any endpoint accepts them as real credentials or if preview data mixes with production.

nodes.label: Fake Success on Settings/Telegram
nodes.rationale: setRestaurantBotToken / setSummaryBotToken return fixed success without saving or validating the token; user believes Telegram/daily summaries are enabled when they are not.

nodes.label: Website Solutions Proposals
nodes.rationale: Translates the issues documented in Docs/website-issues.md into executable solutions; ordered execution preferred because some items depend on architecture and auth fixes first.

nodes.label: Restaurant Creation Page
nodes.rationale: createRestaurant server function verifies session, creates the restaurant with owner_id and an admin role atomically, redirects to /dashboard, and blocks authenticated users without a restaurant from preview fallback.

nodes.label: Password Reset Implementation
nodes.rationale: Call sendPasswordResetEmail, show a generic message to avoid account enumeration, and validate reset-token expiry before saving a new password.

nodes.label: Real Server Functions
nodes.rationale: Shared session/restaurant/role-ownership checks before every write; perform real Firebase operations server-side and return {data,error} or throw on failure so UI reflects true state.

nodes.label: Server-Side Rate Limiting
nodes.rationale: Keep the local limiter only as a UX optimization; counters move to shared storage keyed by email + network address/session; apply to login, signup, password reset, and role PIN.

nodes.label: Backend Layer Decision
nodes.rationale: Why: mixed Supabase naming over a Firebase adapter hides the real backend; decide Firebase-only or real Supabase, rename the compatibility layer to firebaseClient/typed repositories, and keep a temporary compat layer only during migration.

nodes.label: Firebase Adapter Redesign
nodes.rationale: Replace the generic Proxy with small typed per-domain operations, implement or forbid like/ilike, fail loudly on unsupported operations, separate preview client from real Firebase client, and add query tests.

nodes.label: OAuth and Realtime (Skipped)
nodes.rationale: Decision: social login (Google/Apple) removed entirely, so the OAuth part is not implemented; scope limited to Realtime only if needed (Firestore onSnapshot or declared polling).

nodes.label: Reduce any Usage
nodes.rationale: Define typed entities (restaurant, order, employee, role, product, settings) and unified result types; replace any first in auth and sensitive layers; use unknown with narrowing at data boundaries.

nodes.label: Separate Preview from Real Users
nodes.rationale: Mark preview mode explicitly (query param or documented demo session), allow mock data only with no real session, redirect authenticated no-restaurant users to /setup, and add a guard blocking mock writes from reaching production.

nodes.label: Complete i18n
nodes.rationale: Either ship full resources for declared languages or remove fr/en from supportedLngs; move hardcoded JSX strings into i18n keys and test RTL, number/currency formatting, and navigation per language.

nodes.label: OAuth Callback Fix (Obsolete)
nodes.rationale: Decision: after complete social-login removal there is no auth/callback route and no need for this solution.

nodes.label: Secure Preview Tokens
nodes.rationale: mock_* tokens must be invalid outside local preview, never sent to the auth service, blocked by an environment check in production, and preview data kept in separate collections.

nodes.label: Prevent Fake Success Messages
nodes.rationale: Server functions return real results; no success toast until a confirmed save; show failure with retry; never return bot tokens in responses or store them in localStorage.

nodes.label: Five-Phase Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Phases: (1) prevent deploy failure, (2) complete account cycle incl. removing social login, (3) bind functions to real data with permissions, (4) security/quality incl. server rate limiting and preview separation, (5) i18n and UX; plus a pre-launch checklist.
